_comment: Where to LOOK, never what to store. Every field of every record comes
out of the document the URL serves; nothing in this file reaches the
database, including the notes. See collectors/primary_chase.py.
Assembled 2026-08-04 from the recall investigation into the three
largest private AI rounds of 2026, each of which was discovered by the
news collectors and then lost downstream. The primary document was
'archive_fallback': the publisher's host refuses automated requests
(openai.com answers 403 to every non-interactive client). The archived
copy of the SAME url is read instead; the cited source_url is still the
publisher's own permalink, because that is the document.

leads.note: Anthropic Series H, announced May 2026. Absent from the database entirely.
OpenAI's March 2026 close. Absent from the database entirely; every copy we ever saw was a rewrite, and the yahoo copies were host-blocked.
Anthropic Series G, February 2026. Held in the database from a secondary outlet; the primary is here to corroborate the figure.
